newsitem.title: UK: UK govt considers London Tube privatisation - FT.
newsitem.headline: UK govt considers London Tube privatisation - FT.

text.p: Britain's newly elected Labour government is considering selling a controlling stake in London's underground railway network to inject private funds into the crumbling system, the Financial Times newspaper said.

The newspaper said in its Monday edition that the plans had come to light after deputy prime minister John Prescott left policy papers in a room with journalists from the BBC after recording a television interview.

The report said Prescott had confirmed he was exploring all forms of public-private partnerships for the system. It said the Department of Transport believed the whole network could be sold for between one billion and two billion stg.
The newspaper noted that Labour had opposed the Conservative government's plans to privatise the network.
